relationships.subject: bradykinin B2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: These results collectively demonstrate that BK mediates ER calcium store release by activating ITPR1.

relationships.subject: ITPR1
relationships.evidence_quote: BK evoked ITPR1-dependent ER calcium release in TG neurons

relationships.subject: Icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Local injection of the selective B2 receptor antagonist Icatibant into the TG significantly attenuated pIONT-induced mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: Icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with Icatibant (100 nM) for 30 min significantly reversed this hyperexcitable state

relationships.subject: 2-APB
relationships.evidence_quote: 2-APB, by inhibiting ITPR1, blocks BK-mediated calcium release, thereby reversing neuronal hyperexcitability and ultimately alleviating pain behavior

relationships.subject: trigeminal neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the mRNA levels of the BK B2 receptor were significantly upregulated on postoperative days 3, 7, and 21, peaking on day 7

key_findings: pIONT upregulated BK and B2 receptor in the trigeminal ganglion (B2 in NF200+, CGRP+, IB4+ neurons); B1 rose only at day 21.
B2 receptor blockade with Icatibant relieved allodynia and neuronal hyperexcitability; BK-evoked ER calcium release required ITPR1 (2-APB, Itpr1-siRNA).
